claim_boundaries.profile_handshake_declaration: self-declared claim; not proof of implementation
claim_boundaries.acs_core: authenticates channel and binds agent to Guardian decisions; does not establish strict policies or a secure deployment
claim_boundaries.prompt_injection: ACS does not prevent prompt injection; it makes actions gateable and visible
claim_boundaries.guardian_compromise: tamper-evidence against a compromised Guardian requires ACS-Crypto and ACS-Audit profiles; ACS-Core HMAC baseline alone is insufficient
claim_boundaries.complete_mediation: hook conformance does not prove every route capable of the protected effect traverses an enforcement point
claim_boundaries.effect_observation: signed hook, tool result, Guardian decision or provider assertion does not itself prove independently observed protected-resource effect
claim_boundaries.institutional_authority: ACS protocol conformance does not establish owner legitimacy, current institutional authority or rights compliance

notes: skill lifecycle hooks SHOULD be emitted when the AgBOM includes skill components
evaluate mandatory minimum and additional observable hook coverage as distinct axes

dispositions.modify_supported_behavior: apply Guardian-modified operation according to normative composition rules
dispositions.modify_unsupported_behavior: Guardian substitutes DENY with reason_codes containing modify_unsupported and emits an audit event

session_context.chain_head: Guardian publishes chain head in responses for content-bearing steps
session_context.baseline_signature: HMAC-SHA256 over canonical envelope using HKDF-derived per-session key

adds: OpenTelemetry or OCSF Trace events per supported step, including decisions and provenance
acs-trace.liSE_check: trace field coverage and distinction among decision, PEP, dispatch, provider response and observed effect

adds: canonical Agent Bill of Materials serialization
acs-inspect.liSE_check: bounded inventory completeness, provenance, freshness and dependency closure

acs-inspect-dynamic.liSE_check: dynamic tools, models, memory stores, skills, knowledge sources and peers are reflected in versioned deltas

trust_field.default_practice: Guardian derives trust from origin and source_id under local policy

acs-provenance.liSE_check: source authenticity, authority, competence, purpose and dependency independence remain separate

acs-crypto.purpose: asymmetric signatures and external verifiability beyond shared-secret HMAC
acs-crypto.liSE_check: verify actual signature algorithms, key lifecycle, subject binding, currentness and compromise recovery

acs-audit.liSE_check: verify request-content commitment and preserve omissions, forks, genesis and independent ingress coverage

multi_tenancy.liSE_treatment: tenant isolation must be separately owner/deployment-qualified; do not attribute it to ACS-Core

a2a.liSE_treatment: report A2A wrapping as unsupported under v0.1.4; no conformance inference from namespace reservation

must_not: treat hook presence as complete route mediation
treat toolCallResult as independent effect evidence
